I've been eating more garlic lately, to help me recover from the cold.

opening.text: I've had a feeling that the room is spinning, and it started this morning. It's low-grade, not intense. I feel off balance and I've been feeling nauseous. I've taken diphenhydramine to help me sleep, and I've been eating more garlic lately to help me recover from the cold.
